description: Close substrate gap auto-minted-child-gaps-monopolize-the-cap-1-compose-lane. Add one more exclusion of the same form: cap how many gaps may be admitted per distinct edit_site file in a single cycle, and record each excluded candidate under the reason edit_site_saturated so it appears in the admission tally. Do not close, delete or rewrite any gap; change admission only.
